ITEM 1 | Thin cucumber-like slices, pale-to-bright green skin edges with lighter pale green flesh, cut into half-moon wedges about 4-5 cm long and 1 cm thick, glossy wet surface, arranged in a loose cluster on the upper left of the plate | 45
ITEM 2 | Sliced meat pieces, grey-brown outer edges with pinkish-tan interior, fibrous and firm, moist-looking surface, two main slices about 6 cm long and 2 cm thick lying side by side, slightly browned at edges | 60
ITEM 3 | Small browned piece of meat, golden-brown crust with darker char spots, irregular chunk about 3 cm by 2 cm and 1 cm thick, sitting at the lower left next to the sliced meat | 15
ITEM 4 | Baked square portion, golden-brown flaky top with crisp edges, pale cream interior with visible flecks of green herbs, slightly moist, sits on the right side of the plate, roughly 8 cm by 6 cm and 3 cm tall | 110
ITEM 5 | Small scattered crumbs, pale tan and light brown, dry and granular, a few scattered around the center of the plate near the meat | 3
